races.display_title: Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict: Plenty of these look longer-term projects but CHOCTAW NATION shaped promisingly behind one who set a tall standard for a maiden on debut at Navan 25 days ago. Beating the rest handsomely himself on that occasion, he's clearly another above-average Ballydoyle colt and rates the one to beat with improvement forthcoming. Book of Kells and State of Play are a couple of likely newcomers before betting clues, with Cracks and Sparks and Adversity completing the shortlist. CHOCTAW NATION (IRE) BOOK OF KELLS (IRE) STATE OF PLAY (FR)

races.display_title: Mongey Communications Sprint Handicap
races.verdict: GAZELLE D'OR is very well weighted these days and with the expectation of this being a good test by 5f standards, she could be the answer. Stag Night arrives at the very top of his game so he's an obvious threat, with Gerrit's Gem also of some interest. GAZELLE D'OR (IRE) STAG NIGHT (IRE) GERRIT'S GEM (IRE)

races.display_title: Ryans Cleaning Race
races.verdict: EXCELLENT BELIEVE can cement his positive start for the Stephen Thorne stable by getting his head back in front here. Unique Journey is the obvious threat after his smart effort to win a 6f course handicap last month. Best of the rest may be Storm Ready , who has quickly reached a useful level when winning both starts this autumn. EXCELLENT BELIEVE UNIQUE JOURNEY (IRE) STORM READY (IRE)

races.display_title: Isuzu Ireland Handicap
races.verdict: A wide-open handicap that may go the way of LADY MARY HEATH , who looked to have plenty up her sleeve when winning at Punchestown on Thursday. Therewillbeglory and Spacebound are a couple of obvious dangers, with Loingseoir and Thru and Thru lurking on potentially dangerous marks. LADY MARY HEATH (IRE) THEREWILLBEGLORY (IRE) SPACEBOUND

races.display_title: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: RED OAK signed off his novice hurdling campaign with a decisive success at Hexham and he can continue to go the right way now tackling fences. Next Twist is surely better than he was able to show on his chase debut and remains with potential after a summer break, whilst Tigers Moon progressed over the smaller obstacles last season and is also respected. RED OAK (IRE) NEXT TWIST (FR) TIGERS MOON
